Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that performs a 3D DC inversion of a dipole-dipole array using the SimPEG library. The model should consist of two spheres, one conductive and the other resistive, compared to the background. The inversion should be restrained to the Core Mesh using an Active Cells mapping combined with an exponential mapping to invert in log conductivity space. The code should also include the creation of a synthetic Dipole-Dipole Survey and a Tikhonov Inversion. Finally, the code should generate a plot of the ground truth and the inverted model, both vertically and horizontally.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from discretize import TensorMesh
from SimPEG import maps, data, data_misfit, regularization, optimization, inverse_problem, inversion, directives
from SimPEG.electromagnetics.static import resistivity as dc
from SimPEG.utils import mkvc

# Mesh parameters
cs, ncx, ncy, ncz, npad = 5.0, 20, 20, 20, 8
hx = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncx), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hy = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncy), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hz = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncz)]
mesh = TensorMesh([hx, hy, hz], x0="CCC")

# Model parameters
background_conductivity = 1e-2  # S/m
conductive_sphere_conductivity = 1e-1  # S/m
resistive_sphere_conductivity = 1e-3  # S/m
sphere1_center = np.array([0.0, -20.0, -30.0])
sphere1_radius = 15.0
sphere2_center = np.array([0.0, 20.0, -30.0])
sphere2_radius = 15.0

# Define active cells (below surface)
z_surface = 0.0
actv = mesh.cell_centers[:, 2] < z_surface

# Build model
model = background_conductivity * np.ones(mesh.nC)
cc = mesh.cell_centers

# Conductive sphere
sphere1 = np.linalg.norm(cc - sphere1_center, axis=1) < sphere1_radius
# Resistive sphere
sphere2 = np.linalg.norm(cc - sphere2_center, axis=1) < sphere2_radius
model[sphere1] = conductive_sphere_conductivity
model[sphere2] = resistive_sphere_conductivity

# Only active cells
model = model[actv]

# Mapping: ActiveCells -> ExpMap (log conductivity)
exp_map = maps.ExpMap()
act_map = maps.InjectActiveCells(mesh, actv, background_conductivity)
model_map = exp_map * act_map

# Survey: Dipole-Dipole
xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax = -40, 40, -40, 40
n_electrodes = 21
x_electrodes = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, n_electrodes)
y_electrodes = np.zeros_like(x_electrodes)
z_electrodes = np.zeros_like(x_electrodes)
electrode_locations = np.c_[x_electrodes, y_electrodes, z_electrodes]

source_list = []
for i in range(n_electrodes - 3):
    A = electrode_locations[i]
    B = electrode_locations[i + 1]
    for j in range(i + 2, n_electrodes - 1):
        M = electrode_locations[j]
        N = electrode_locations[j + 1]
        rx = dc.receivers.Dipole(M, N)
        src = dc.sources.Dipole([rx], A, B)
        source_list.append(src)
survey = dc.Survey(source_list)

# Problem
problem = dc.Simulation3DNodal(
    mesh, survey=survey, sigmaMap=model_map, solver=utils.SolverLU
)

# Synthetic data
np.random.seed(42)
data_synthetic = problem.make_synthetic_data(
    model, relative_error=0.05, noise_floor=1e-5, add_noise=True
)

# Inversion setup
dmis = data_misfit.L2DataMisfit(simulation=problem, data=data_synthetic)
reg = regularization.Simple(mesh, indActive=actv, mapping=exp_map)
opt = optimization.InexactGaussNewton(maxIter=15)
inv_prob = inverse_problem.BaseInvProblem(dmis, reg, opt)
betaest = directives.BetaEstimate_ByEig(beta0_ratio=1e0)
target = directives.TargetMisfit()
save = directives.SaveEveryIteration()
inv = inversion.BaseInversion(inv_prob, directiveList=[betaest, target, save])

# Initial model (log conductivity)
m0 = np.log(np.ones(actv.sum()) * background_conductivity)
recovered_model = inv.run(m0)

# Plotting
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

# Vertical cross-section (Y=0)
ind_y0 = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.cell_centers[:, 1]))
slice_y0 = mesh.cell_centers[:, 1] == mesh.cell_centers[ind_y0, 1]
model_full = act_map * np.exp(m0)
recovered_full = act_map * np.exp(recovered_model)

im0 = axes[0, 0].tricontourf(
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_y0, 0],
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_y0, 2],
    np.log10(model_full[slice_y0]),
    20,
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[0, 0].set_title("True Model (Vertical Y=0)")
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel("x (m)")
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("z (m)")
fig.colorbar(im0, ax=axes[0, 0], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

im1 = axes[0, 1].tricontourf(
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_y0, 0],
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_y0, 2],
    np.log10(recovered_full[slice_y0]),
    20,
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[0, 1].set_title("Inverted Model (Vertical Y=0)")
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel("x (m)")
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel("z (m)")
fig.colorbar(im1, ax=axes[0, 1], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

# Horizontal slice (Z=-30)
ind_z = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.cell_centers[:, 2] + 30))
slice_z = np.abs(mesh.cell_centers[:, 2] + 30) < cs / 2

im2 = axes[1, 0].tricontourf(
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_z, 0],
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_z, 1],
    np.log10(model_full[slice_z]),
    20,
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[1, 0].set_title("True Model (Horizontal Z=-30m)")
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("x (m)")
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel("y (m)")
fig.colorbar(im2, ax=axes[1, 0], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

im3 = axes[1, 1].tricontourf(
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_z, 0],
    mesh.cell_centers[slice_z, 1],
    np.log10(recovered_full[slice_z]),
    20,
    cmap="viridis",
)
axes[1, 1].set_title("Inverted Model (Horizontal Z=-30m)")
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("x (m)")
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel("y (m)")
fig.colorbar(im3, ax=axes[1, 1], label="log10 Conductivity (S/m)")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
